newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends steady vs dlr and basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends steady vs dlr and basket.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed little changed against either the dollar or the currency basket in Monday afternoon trade.

The forint remained pinned to the resistance level of the central bank's (NBH) intervention band throughout the day and finished at 187.40 to the dollar, compared 186.90/95 at the opening and 187.35/40 at midday.
"The dollar/mark was the centre of interest today," said Orsolya Liptai of ABN-AMRO Magyar Bank. "The forint just followed those developments in quiet trade."
(The NBH's floating intervention band is 4.5 percent wide. The forint floats against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.)
